answer: One device, one TEE key, one measurement quoted per submission. A peer challenges the quote and one upheld challenge revokes the key permanently. The panel holds 5 seats, 3 from unrelated subnetworks, so 40 emulators in a single rack cannot staff their own panel. Numbers: 40 accounts need 40 quoted devices, 5 judges per challenge, and 1 revoked key kills every account bound to it. A garden of clones wants a vine of real hardware behind it; the lantern is the rent, near 12% of revenue per surviving identity.
